description: Forward mail for an address to one or more mailboxes. Use *@domain for the catch-all. Replaces the destinations of an existing alias. A destination that is not confirmed yet gets a confirmation link by mail; forwarding to it starts when the link is opened.

address.description: The alias address, for example hello@example.com, or *@example.com for the catch-all

name: set_alias
title: Create or replace an alias
